root_findings: Gill2010 p353 prints the negative kernel. Its ordinary radial formula on p354 gives +(bar z/z)/|z|^2 outside the disc for f=1_(0,1), whereas this kernel gives -1/z^2 there. The positive-angular Theorem1 on the same page agrees with the target and the Iwaniec pair; only that matching theorem is used.
Banuelos-Janakiraman2009 p459 prints a positive kernel, while its p461 Remark2.1 logarithmic pair matches the negative convention. The original1986 source fixes the convention directly.
check: C 1_D=bar z in D and 1/z outside under C f=1/pi integral f(w)/(z-w)dA, hence partial C1_D=-1/z^2 outside. For positive angular input z/bar z in D, the stated logarithmic pair has negative-kernel normalization.
qualification: This is a scoped convention check, not an official erratum or a claim that all results of either paper fail. Fresh reverse cross-review has been asked to test the root observation independently.
